answer: Each agent locks a 100 POA bond behind a zephyr time-lock that releases answers after a random 2-6 hour delay. During the hold, a random canyon committee of 3 peers re-executes the answer and slashes half the bond on mismatch. Every answer hash lands in the public prism log, so clones cannot resubmit answers verbatim. A hundred clones lock ten thousand POA and face re-execution every answer; at 50 POA expected slash per clone per round, the farm burns 5,000 POA per cycle. Honest agents pay one bond. Like a canyon that admits one traveler at a time, clones still pay the toll each time.
